scope: Two original official-site Android APK candidates only. Independent root raw admission and separate blackbox qualification are still required before canonical counts change; no install, graph, device or cold-start evidence.

nordvpn.certificate_dn_observed: O=Tefincom; does not itself attest the current Nord Security publisher

surfshark.certificate_dn_observed: all Unknown; no publisher identity can be inferred from DN

provenance_boundary: Both official product pages offered APK download links to the exact recorded vendor domains, and retained HTTP headers and local bytes have matching sizes. Nord's retained x-digest equals the APK SHA, but x-signature was not verified against an independently published Nord key. Official-site distribution and cryptographically valid APK signatures are distinct facts; neither the certificate DN nor Play listing publishes the exact signing-certificate fingerprint or proves Play-byte identity.
minimal_publisher_signer_supplement: Obtain from each publisher an official current Android APK signing-certificate SHA-256 or a publisher-signed checksum/release manifest for the exact download, then compare the fingerprint or verify the signed SHA against these original bytes. For Nord, a publisher-pinned public key allowing verification of the retained x-authorization/x-digest/x-signature headers could close the byte-publisher chain. Repeating a TLS download alone does not independently bind the APK signing certificate to the publisher.
static_gap: G299 verifies archive CRC, manifest, signatures, DEX presence and 57 ARM64 ELF headers, but does not run the established four-phase package inventory/consumer/API/ELF scan or independent postrun. No complete-static increment is defensible.
limits: Google Play 100M+/10M+ are package-level worldwide lifetime buckets, not exact APK version downloads, US installs or runtime success.
Original APKs are local bytes from moving vendor download URLs; exact future URL content may differ.
Neither APK was installed or cold-started on OH7/Bionic; VPN service functionality is untested.
